title: Cedar Threshold
description: B natural first brightens an F-major song, then draws its phrases towards C. A complete second song establishes that rival centre before flowing passagework unsettles it. The shortened F-major return accepts the same B-to-C motion, finally resolving it inside the recovered tonic.
technical_note: Keep the lyrical phrases distinct from their quicker connecting figures. The single sixteenth-note passage should remain light, with the bass providing a steady frame. Hear B natural moving towards C throughout the tonal journey; in the last bar it resolves over a held F-major chord.

performance.note: Authored phrase breathing and melodic voicing; independent rhythm is written in the score, with a shared tempo map.
